name: Native C++ Music Library Manager and Player

mentions.name: Native C++ Music Library Manager and Player
mentions.description: A native music library manager and player for Windows, macOS and other Unix systems, self-built in modern C++ with a 100% custom UI (Direct2D/CoreGraphics/Cairo backends). It aims for responsiveness, power-user friendliness and compactness, with fast incremental imports, multiple column sorting, multiple element selection, keyboard-first navigation, and strict separation of core logic from the UI thread to avoid lag and hangs. Its UI takes inspiration from pre-2010 skeuomorphic, dense interfaces.
mentions.problem: The author finds existing music players laggy and hang-prone; foobar2000 doesn't meet their requirements, and an old unsupported version of iTunes they find satisfying doesn't support FLAC.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m self-teaching modern C++ by developing a native music library manager and player for Windows, macOS and other Unix systems.
